annotations.title: Browse an AINSOF genre or mood

description: Use only when the user explicitly wants to browse an AINSOF category or tag, such as a genre, mood, instrument or use. Supply the exact tag and facet. For written creative briefs, refinements, artist or track names, use search_music instead. Returns results in ranked order and a cursor when there are more; to continue, call this tool with the same tag, facet, scope, and cursor. Keep the page size unchanged.

page_size.description: Number of primary tracks per page; separately displayed versions may add rows.

name: browse_tag
